title: How Item Controls Work
body: Shop purchases spend wallet first, then bank. Essentials are always available; bonus slots rotate daily at 4 AM Mountain. Items have unlimited stock. Gated items remain visible. Recipes are account-bound; tools must be manually equipped. Selling shows a confirmation and respects item/category locks. Sell Duplicates keeps one normal copy or the highest-quality crafted chair. Gifts are named; tools, crafted chairs and recipes cannot be gifted. Crafting may fail, consume some materials and produce scrap; every attempt grants hidden skill progress. Collections give prestige only. Opening a box consumes it once and atomically grants its reward.

gift.member: An eligible server member who receives the named gift.
gift.item: Copy the owned item ID from Inventory.

inventory_filters.filter: Comma-separated type, rarity, quality, lock: for example material,,,locked. Leave blank fields to include any.
inventory_filters.sort: newness, rarity, type, quality, lock, or sell value.

steps: Open /shop and inspect price and gating requirements.
Buy an essential tool, then equip it from /inventory.
Use Search / Sort / Filter and inspect a locked item.
Review a Sell Duplicates confirmation; Cancel keeps everything.
Learn a recipe and inspect materials in /craft.
